Given $△ABC$ shown above, which of the following diagrams represents the height corresponding to $\overset{―}{AB}?$

examples.knowledge_point: Finding a Height Corresponding to an Extended Base
examples.problem:
Consider the triangle $ABC$ shown below. Construct the height corresponding to $\overline{BC}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945712/assets/72b40526cafc5d1db902ea9947a2808020dfadcf6a84238e8e3a2459ca95fe07.png)
examples.worked_solution:
The height (or altitude) corresponding to $\overline{BC}$ is a line segment that 

- runs from the opposite vertex $A$ to the line $\overset{\longleftrightarrow}{BC},$ and

- is perpendicular to $\overset{\longleftrightarrow}{BC}.$

To draw the height, we proceed as follows:

- Extend the line segment $\overline{BC}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945712/assets/010d2c4de6c3df93112295eb2351247c2162a0d84a1f6e122fdca71dca72c168.png)

- Draw the perpendicular from $A$ to $\overset{\longleftrightarrow}{BC}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945712/assets/392d7d23590557ccce29b25cecabb276ee875f86c172ce15c845c13668939933.png)
